[[Chen Po Chin]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] who exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for armor or other items of value.

==Dialogue==
:''"You there, are you looking for work? I am in need of some [[Mantid Pincer|mantid pincers]], but unfortunately, the [[Mantid|mantids]] are a little reluctant to part with them. I know of this eccentric writer who uses something he calls a 'quill.' Why he cannot write with a traditional brush is beyond me, but then again, he is not known for his conventional ways, and I'm not one to complain when there is a profit to be made! If you bring me 3 Mantid Pincers, I will give you this in return:"''
